secretsInjection.description: External Secrets injection (app-secrets / app-db-secrets ExternalSecrets). Requires External Secrets Operator and the referenced store to exist.

enabled.description: Master switch: create the app-secrets ExternalSecret.

database.description: Also create the app-db-secrets ExternalSecret and inject the nconf connection env that reads it (db__client, db__connection__charset/database/host/port/user/password/ssl__ca) into every container and initContainer. App-declared env wins. Only when enabled is true.

refreshInterval.description: ESO refresh interval for both ExternalSecrets.

name.description: Name of the (Cluster)SecretStore to read from.

kind.description: Kind of the store: ClusterSecretStore or SecretStore.

migrations.description: Database migrations Job: runs `command` in the app's own container (image, envFrom and env, including the injected database vars) at ArgoCD sync-wave -1, after the preview database (-2) and before the workloads (0).

command.description: Command that runs the migrations, e.g. [./node_modules/.bin/knex, migrate:latest]. Required when enabled.

controller.description: Controller (under controllers) whose container the Job copies.

container.description: Container in that controller to copy image, envFrom and env from.

backoffLimit.description: Job retries before the sync fails.

hotReload.description: git-sync based hot reload for PR previews.

enabled.description: Enable hot reload for this release (PR previews).

container.description: Container in that controller whose command/args are replaced.

repo.description: Git repository to sync (SSH form, git-sync's GITSYNC_REPO), e.g. git@github.com:TryGhost/Daisy.js.git. Empty = preview.gitRepo, itself defaulting to git@github.com:<preview.owner>/<release namespace>.git.

ref.description: Git ref to follow (git-sync's GITSYNC_REF). Empty = derived at render time as refs/pull/<preview.prNumber>/head. Set explicitly (e.g. a branch) to override.

workspace.description: emptyDir mount path shared by git-sync and the app container.

staleWorktreeTimeout.description: How long old worktrees are kept so the watcher can stop the old process.

root.description: git-sync --root; the checkout is published at <root>/<link>.

link.description: Symlink name under root that git-sync publishes atomically (--link).

uid.description: git-sync runs as this uid/gid; the pod's fsGroup is set to gid so the mounted SSH key is readable.

gid.description: gid git-sync runs as; also the pod fsGroup so the mounted SSH key is readable.

extraArgs.description: Extra args appended to both git-sync containers.

secretName.description: Secret holding the read-only deploy key (by convention the app-secrets Secret created by secretsInjection).

key.description: Key inside that Secret. Defaults to "<namespace>-git-sync-ssh" (namespace == app name by convention), matching the Terraform argocd module: per-PR preview releases are named <app>-<pr>, but the deploy key is provisioned per app, not per release.

knownHosts.description: Pinned SSH host key(s) for the git host, rendered into a ConfigMap mounted at /etc/git-hosts/known_hosts (host-key verification on). No runtime lookups: pods boot without network calls to GitHub's API. https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/githubs-ssh-key-fingerprints

ssh.description: SSH deploy key and host key settings.

command.description: Entrypoint for the app container while hot reloading. The default runs the generated args script under tini.

args.description: Args for the app container. Empty = generated script: ln -sfn <nodeModules> <workspace>/node_modules exec <devCommand> --legacy-watch --watch <checkout> --exec 'sh -c "cd <checkout> && exec <run>"' Set a non-empty list to take full control (command is used verbatim).

devCommand.description: Dev runner in the image (e.g. `pnpm dev` running nodemon).

run.description: Command the runner (re)starts inside the synced checkout.

nodeModules.description: Dependencies directory baked into the image, symlinked into the workspace.

app.description: How the app container runs while hot reloading.

previewDatabase.description: Per-PR preview database: create (wave 0) and drop (PostDelete hook) Jobs against the app's managed MySQL.

image.description: MySQL client image used by both Jobs.

secretName.description: Secret holding the MySQL connection details (pairs with secretsInjection.database, which creates app-db-secrets).

keys.description: Keys inside secretName holding host, port, user and password.

preview.description: Per-render preview facts. Set by the pull-request ApplicationSet as Helm parameters; apps never write them. Empty outside previews.

gitRepo.description: SSH clone URL for hotReload. Empty = git@github.com:<owner>/<release namespace>.git.

owner.description: GitHub owner used when deriving gitRepo.

gateway.description: Gateway attachment: platform facts and dedicated-gateway configuration. Routes select their gateway via route.<id>.gateway; this key selects nothing by itself.

name.description: Name of the shared internal (VPC-only) Gateway.
Name of the shared public Gateway.

dedicated.description: Configuration for dedicated (per-app) Gateways, rendered when a route selects dedicated-internal or dedicated-external. Each is its own DO load balancer.

issuer.description: ClusterIssuer for each dedicated Gateway's per-host certificate.

gateway.description: Which gateway this route attaches to when parentRefs is not set: shared-internal (default), shared-external, dedicated-internal or dedicated-external. dedicated-* renders a per-app Gateway (its own DO load balancer) with certificate and HTTP->HTTPS redirect.
